description: Source code for the 'ProcessStatementOfAccounts' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, report generation, email sending, and customer data retrieval functions.

classes.name: ProcessStatementOfAccounts
classes.description: A Document class representing the process statement of accounts, with validation logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document fields, sets default subject and body, and auto email date adjustments.

methods.name: get_report_pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF report for the statement of accounts, optionally consolidated.

methods.name: get_customers_based_on_territory_or_customer_group
methods.description: Retrieves customers based on territory or customer group.

methods.name: get_customers_based_on_sales_person
methods.description: Retrieves customers associated with a sales person.

methods.name: get_recipients_and_cc
methods.description: Determines email recipients and CC list for a customer.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Prepares email context data for a customer.

methods.name: fetch_customers
methods.description: Fetches customer list based on collection type and name.

methods.name: get_customer_emails
methods.description: Retrieves primary and billing emails for a customer.

methods.name: download_statements
methods.description: Downloads the statement as a PDF file.

methods.name: send_emails
methods.description: Sends statement emails to customers, optionally scheduling next batch.

methods.name: send_auto_email
methods.description: Triggers automatic email sending for due statements.
